requirements.requirement: The system must define a clinical trial scoring schema that includes at least three distinct measures derived from clinical_trials_service.py fields.
The system must represent each measure with a name, description, input field mapping, and normalized score range.
The system must define normalization rules that convert raw trial data into a consistent numeric scale between 0 and 1.
The system must define a deterministic weighting configuration where each measure has an explicit weight value.
The system must enforce that the sum of all measure weights equals 1.0.
The system must define a composite score formula as the weighted sum of normalized measure scores.
The system must define the output schema including composite score and individual measure contributions.
The system must ensure the scoring schema is deterministic such that identical inputs always produce identical outputs.
The system must map at least one measure to trial phase data from clinical_trials_service.py.
The system must map at least one measure to trial status data from clinical_trials_service.py.
The system must define how missing or null input values are handled during normalization.
The system must assign a default normalized value or exclusion rule for measures with missing data.
The system must ensure the schema is serializable as a structured configuration object (e.g., JSON-compatible).
The system must define valid value ranges or categories for each input field used in scoring.
The system must prevent inclusion of measures that cannot be derived from clinical_trials_service.py outputs.
The system must define explicit ordering or precedence if multiple normalization rules could apply to a measure.
The system must validate that all required measures are present in the schema before it can be used by downstream logic.
The system must define human-readable labels for each measure for downstream explainability use.
The system must reject schema configurations where any weight is negative.
The system must reject schema configurations where normalization outputs fall outside the 0 to 1 range.
The system must support LLM-readable schema descriptions that clearly describe each measure’s purpose and calculation.
The system must structure schema definitions so an LLM can extract measure names, weights, and formulas without ambiguity.
The system must ensure measure descriptions avoid non-deterministic language (e.g., 'approximately', 'heuristic').
The system must ensure that schema definitions can be consumed by downstream LLM explanation components without additional transformation.
The system must define consistent naming conventions for measures to prevent ambiguity in LLM interpretation.
The system must ensure each measure includes an example input and expected normalized output for LLM grounding.
The system must define schema metadata indicating versioning for future updates.
The system must fail schema validation if fewer than three measures are defined.
